policy.include: Current Three.js app, runtime resources, asset sources/licenses, configs/lockfile, scripts, references, docs, report metadata and directly linked report assets.
policy.exclude: Git metadata, app-lite changes, dependencies, generated caches/build outputs, secrets, raw logs/profiles, unlinked historical screenshot and baked-report archives.
policy.preserve: Destination Git, app-lite source, installed dependencies, existing report evidence; overwritten/deleted managed files backed up outside destination.
